title: Titan Pro 15K Cherry Cola Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: Cherry Cola pairs the familiar sweetness of Cola with a smooth Cherry twist for a flavour that’s nostalgic yet refreshing. The mesh-coil pod ensures steady flavour and vapour output, while the refill container keeps the coil consistently saturated for reliable performance. Each Titan Pro 15K Prefilled Pod pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill container, purpose-built for the Titan Pro 15K device. Designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping at 20mg Nic Salt, it delivers discreet vapour and full-bodied taste with every draw. Explore our Titan Pro 15K refill selection and find additional Titan Pro pods flavours you’ll love. How To Set Up Titan Pro 15K Pods Step 1 Insert the prefilled pod into the Titan Pro 15K device until it clicks. Step 2 Fit the 10ml refill container securely into the base compartment. Step 3 Inhale on the mouthpiece to vape. Replace both when empty. ✅ You're all set!
